• One Hass Avocado
• Fresh avocados are exactly what you need in healthy snacks, power bowls, avocado dressing, salads and avocado salsa
• Like all avocados, hass avocados are the lowest sugar fruit and provide unsaturated “good fats” that help absorb Vitamin A, Vitamin D, Vitamin K and Vitamin E
• A cholesterol free fruit that contains nearly 20 vitamins, minerals and phytonutrients including Vitamin E, Vitamin K, Vitamin C and Vitamins B5 and B9
• Ripe avocados should yield to gentle pressure without leaving indentations or feeling mushy

Avocados aren’t just great-tasting fresh produce items, but they are a nutrient-dense food enjoyed around the world. Hass avocados are a versatile ingredient that can be used in many different types of recipes and dishes because of their creamy texture and mild flavor. Enjoy these hass avocados on their own or in Mexican food like tacos or burritos, as part of healthy snacks, in a fresh salad, fresh guacamole, avocado spread or on avocado toast. Not only is a hass avocado a great ingredient to use in numerous recipes, but it is also a healthy food that contributes unsaturated “good” fats and nearly 20 vitamins, minerals and phytonutrients including Vitamin E, Vitamin K, Vitamin C and Vitamins B5 and B9. A ripe avocado will have dark green to nearly black skin color and a bumpy skin texture; however, color isn’t always the best indicator of ripeness. Ripe avocados should yield to gentle pressure without leaving indentations or feeling mushy. Avocados with a slightly bumpy texture should be ripe in 1 to 2 days. They will also be somewhat firm and have a dark green and black speckled color. Order an avocado and you’ll see that the possibilities are deliciously endless.

With a bold, refreshing taste of ginger ale, its crisp and bubbly flavor makes for the perfect carbonated beverage you can reach for to satisfy your thirst. So, whether you’re looking for a quick recharge during the day or winding down at night, caffeine-free Schweppes Ginger Ale always hits the spot. Starting way back in 1870, Schweppes Ginger Ale carries on the tradition established by Jacob Schweppe in 1783. Perfect as a mixer for favorites such as the Moscow Mule and Bulldog to new classics like the Amaretto Kick and the Ginger Snap, there’s no end to the possible delicious cocktail mixing opportunities. However, Schweppes Ginger Ale can easily be enjoyed on its own when you’re in the mood for a smooth, delicious drink. With a delicious taste and dependable, crowd-pleasing versatility, there’s nothing quite like a Schweppes Ginger Ale to relax, recharge or refresh!

When it comes to achieving your goals, it takes more than just effort. It takes determination, grit, and the right kind of hydration. That's where POWERADE Mountain Berry Blast steps in. This isn't just any sport drink; it's a hydration powerhouse. With 50% more electrolytes versus the leading sports drink*, POWERADE helps ensure you stay fueled and ready to conquer every challenge thrown your way.

Packed with essential electrolytes, POWERADE is designed to hydrate and replenish you during and after intense workouts. The formula quickly replaces fluids and electrolytes lost through sweat, making it the ideal hydration drink for athletes who demand the best. Plus, POWERADE has Vitamin C to help support energy metabolism and Vitamin B12 to help support normal immune function. These electrolyte drinks help keep your body in top condition, so you can focus on your performance without any distractions.

Whether you're powering through a tough training session or you need a post-workout recovery drink, POWERADE Mountain Berry Blast delivers great taste and hard-working hydration. It's the go-to sports drink for athletes on the go, ensuring you stay hydrated and fueled-up no matter where your journey takes you. Remember, it takes more to be the best, and with POWERADE, you've got the hydration and support you need to realize your goals.

sections.bodyString:
As stewards of the environment, we support sustainable ways to grow coffee and respect the land. In Brazil, that means supporting a partnership with forward-thinking coffee farmers using an innovative and buzzworthy partner – bees.

By introducing beehives to their lands, farmers like Maria Beatriz are using nature’s pollinators to support crop production. Plus, they’re able to earn additional income by selling the bees’ honey. In short, bee pollination helps farmers grow coffee in a more sustainable way and diversify their income. So you can enjoy even more of the smooth, intensely bold taste of Dark Magic The mountains are a special place. It's where Green Mountain Coffee Roasters was born. It's where we developed our adventurous spirit and commitment to improving the lands through sustainably sourced coffee. We're driven to bring the world a richer, better cup of coffee. Be bold. Be alive. Grab a cup and get out there.™ As deep and intense as the night itself. Green Mountain Coffee Roasters Dark Magic is an extra bold blend with dried fruit and chocolate notes, leading to a subtly sweet finish. Made with 100% Arabica coffee. Each K-Cup pod is filled with the freshest ground coffee and brews a perfect, great tasting cup of coffee, every time. Certified Orthodox Union Kosher. sections.bodyString: Medaglia D'Oro Decaffeinated is the authentic Italian espresso coffee - unusually rich, aromatic and delicious. The caffeine is removed using natural ingredients to carefully preserve the extraordinary richness that comes from the finest quality premium coffee beans. These hand-selected Arabica beans are then double roasted and ground to perfection for a rich aroma and robust espresso flavor. Enjoyed since 1924, Medaglia D'Oro continues to be America's largest selling Italian espresso coffee.

Brew Delicious Espresso Every Time: This true espresso can be easily brewed in any espresso maker, Moka pot, or automatic drip coffeemaker. You'll make delicious espresso every time in a variety of tempting ways. Espresso: Fill the bottom of the Moka steam pot with cold water. Place the metal filter on top and fill with espresso. Tamp the espresso tightly. Screw on the top of the machine. Place on the stove at low/medium heat. Let the water come to a slow boil and flow through the espresso to the top of the pot. Pour into your cup. Serve with sugar and a twist of lemon. Cappuccino: Create with equal amounts of steamed milk and espresso. After steaming 2 oz of milk using the frother attachment on your home machine or separate steamer, pour into cup. Then pour the espresso directly through the center, so there is a nice, thick foam rising to the top. Garnish with cinnamon, nutmeg, cocoa powder, or chocolate shavings. Caffe Latte: Warm about 6 oz of milk and add to a 2 oz cup of espresso. Garnish like cappuccino. To Extend the Freshness: Reseal the Medaglia D'Oro can and store in the refrigerator. Do not freeze or place in another container.

Spring Water
There are over 326 million trillion gallons of water on earth, but only 1 billionth of 1% is crisp and refreshing enough to be called Deer Park. Our water is sourced from springs that span across and around the Eastern Seaboard and beyond.
What Is Spring Water Anyway?
Great question. According to the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA): “Spring Water is water derived from an underground formation from which water flows naturally to the surface of the earth at an identified location.” To be able to label our product as “spring water,” we have to satisfy stringent standards — standards we proudly meet or exceed. That’s why every bottle of Deer Park Brand water is labeled as natural.
When Deer Park Brand Spring Water got its start near the crest of the Appalachians, travelers came from all over to enjoy a taste of the water. Today, our natural spring water comes from carefully selected spring sources in five states. We're still honored to serve folks across the region and call this beautiful place our home.

Essentia’s proprietary three-step ionization process produces Overachieving H2O that’s 99.9% pure with a pH of 9.5 or higher and a clean, smooth taste. Step 1: Unwanted particles are removed through microfiltration and reverse osmosis, making Essentia 99.9% pure. Step 2: The water is infused with trace amounts of electrolytes; not just for taste, but to better complement the body’s natural mix. Step 3: Bitter-tasting acidic ions are removed, creating a high alkaline water with pH levels of 9.5 or higher. Available in a variety of sizes, Essentia Water bottles are recyclable, BPA-free plastic bottles available in cases and multi-packs. The 1.5-liter bottle is designed to store easily in the home, office, or personal vehicle for anytime hydration moments.

sections.bodyString:
Spring Water
There are over 326 million trillion gallons of water on earth, but only 1 billionth of 1% is crisp and refreshing enough to be called Deer Park. Our water is sourced from springs that span across and around the Eastern Seaboard and beyond.
What Is Spring Water Anyway?
Great question. According to the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA): “Spring Water is water derived from an underground formation from which water flows naturally to the surface of the earth at an identified location.” To be able to label our product as “spring water,” we have to satisfy stringent standards — standards we proudly meet or exceed. That’s why every bottle of Deer Park Brand water is labeled as natural.
When Deer Park Brand Spring Water got its start near the crest of the Appalachians, travelers came from all over to enjoy a taste of the water. Today, our natural spring water comes from carefully selected spring sources in five states. We're still honored to serve folks across the region and call this beautiful place our home.

• 2.5-gallon plastic jug: convenient spout makes it easy to pour
• Stores easily, perfect for filling glasses or on-the-go containers
• Spring Water: zero calories, no sweeteners and no artificial colors or flavors
• Contains naturally balanced minerals for a crisp, clean taste
• Every bottle is 100% recyclable (excluding label and cap)
• Water source information may vary depending on bottling facility location. Applicable bottle deposits and/or sales tax may apply.
100% Natural Spring Water

Function Water starts off in nature, fresh and natural. The fist step in the process is vapor-distillation. Our water is converted into vapor at super high temperatures. But vapor-distillation is almost too perfect because it also removes the natural minerals and nutrients contained in water. So the docs added in a perfectly balanced formula of electrolytes to help keep your cells operating at their personal best. Electrolytes are like little messengers, helping to send signals, or impulses, between the charged cells throughout your entire body. Proper electrolyte balance is important for maintaining healthy nervous, circulatory and muscular systems within the body. The process is complicated, but simply put it results in the best tasting water, possibly ever.

Spring Water
There are over 326 million trillion gallons of water on earth, but only 1 billionth of 1% is crisp and refreshing enough to be called Deer Park. Our water is sourced from springs that span across and around the Eastern Seaboard and beyond.
What Is Spring Water Anyway?
Great question. According to the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA): “Spring Water is water derived from an underground formation from which water flows naturally to the surface of the earth at an identified location.” To be able to label our product as “spring water,” we have to satisfy stringent standards — standards we proudly meet or exceed. That’s why every bottle of Deer Park Brand water is labeled as natural.
When Deer Park Brand Spring Water got its start near the crest of the Appalachians, travelers came from all over to enjoy a taste of the water. Today, our natural spring water comes from carefully selected spring sources in five states. We're still honored to serve folks across the region and call this beautiful place our home.

sections.bodyString: Enjoy the benefits of refreshment with Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water. With carbonation that tickles your senses, bubbly flavor that brightens your spirit and refreshing taste that satisfies your thirst, Canada Dry is the ideal companion to take on your relaxation journey. For over 100 years, Canada Dry has been creating quality beverages and mixers to enjoy any time of day. Started in 1904 with Pale Ginger Ale, John J. McLaughlin created Canada Dry Ginger Ale as a lighter version of the syrupier ginger ales that were rising in popularity during that time. Today, there are so many more ways to enjoy the great taste of Canada Dry. Made with only the highest quality ingredients, you can enjoy the refreshing taste of Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water in Original, Lemon Lime, Mandarin Orange, and Raspberry flavors. This crisp, bubbly seltzer water gives you the benefits of hydration that you would get from regular water with the taste of sparkling seltzer water. This 100% all-natural sparkling seltzer water also contains no calories, no sodium and no added sugar or sweeteners. You can make delicious cocktails or simply enjoy the taste on its own over ice. When you want hydration, refreshment and great taste, open up a cold Canada Dry Sparkling Seltzer Water to enhance your day.

sections.bodyString: Experience a new level of refreshment, hydration and flavor with Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water. Carbonated, clean and crisp, it’s the perfect beverage to satisfy your thirst that’s also caffeine-free, sodium-free and calorie-free. Plus, with a wide variety of flavors to choose from, you can always find the right flavor to suit your taste. Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water comes in Original, Black Cherry, Concord Grape, Cranberry Lime, Lemon Lime, Orange, Pink Grapefruit, Pomegranate, Raspberry Lime, and Strawberry Mango. Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water carries on the tradition established by Jacob Schweppe in 1783. Perfect all by itself, Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water is also great as a mixer for favorites drinks like Mojitos, Spritzers and Bahama Mamas. In fact, you can use Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water instead of plain water to give any of your favorite drinks a burst of effervescence and flavor! Reach for a Schweppes Sparkling Seltzer Water whenever you need refreshing hydration. With a wide assortment of flavorful options, you’re sure to find more than one favorite!

If you’re looking for variety in your drinks, or a little more flavor in your mixers, the Seagram’s brand offers a wide array of different options—including ginger ale, zero sugar  ginger ale, tonic, and club soda options. So, no matter how you like to mix, there’s a Seagram’s option for you.

A lot of great things happen on the ground, we live here, for one, and that's nothing to shake a stick at. But when it comes to finding some purified water, you've got to look up. When you look up, you just think about things differently. You see faces in the clouds. You admire the clear, blue sky. Heck, if you're lucky you might even see a shooting star or a bald eagle or both. We looked up and were inspired by the clouds to vapor-distill Smartwater. By taking cues from mother nature and then adding electrolytes for taste, we were able to take crisp and pure to a whole new level. So, next time you're searching for some new possibilities (or just some purified water) you know where to look.

 • combining vapor-distilled water, added minerals, and light carbonation, smartwater sparkling delivers a taste that's distinctly pure, crisp and effervescent.
 • smartwater sparkling- similar in taste to seltzer water, soda water, or club soda — is still water turned fizzy through the simple process of carbonation.
 • smartwater sparkling is simply smartwater's vapor-distilled water with added electrolytes made bubbly through delicate carbonation.
 • a delicious drink pairing to any meal, this lightly carbonated water is free of sugar, calories, coloring, and artificial flavors.
 • environmentally conscious bottle is up to 30% plant-based and 100% recyclable

sections.bodyString: Polar Seltzer Premium Sparkling Water. Tiny Bubbles: The sparkle sets us apart. We've been perfecting the process of making our signature bubbles, with their long-lasting carbonation and crispness, since 1882. The bubbles are created by carefully dissolving Co2 into water at high pressure and freezing temperatures without exposing the flavors to oxygen. Other people may add sodium or sweeteners to shortcut the road to quality – we do not. Natural Flavors: The taste of our seltzers is defined by the quality ingredients of the ingredients we used. Our approach is to use only the highest-quality, proprietary combinations of flavors and aromas for depth and complexity. These ingredients are extracted and distilled from natural sources (such as lemon peel, lime, mint, etc.) to create highly concentrated “essences”. Relying on copious amounts of these very precious oils, we never skimp when it comes to taste. Triple-Filtered & Locally Sourced Water: Our water is locally sourced and then triple-filtered with our state-of-the-art process to ensure a consistent and authentic Polar Seltzer taste. NO sodium, fluoride, or other funny business added. This is why Polar Seltzer makes for health smart hydration. Family Made Since 1882: Just water, zillions of tiny bubbles, and great taste. Our family has been crafting Polar Seltzer with these same ingredients since 1882. That’s 138 years to perfect what our great-great-grandfather called the world’s best-tasting bubble recipe. At Polar Beverages we work hard to keep things uncomplicated, refreshing and endlessly creative. Take a sip, and let us know.
Carbonated Water, Natural Flavors

sections.bodyString:
Runa is powerful, clean energy. Unlike other energy drinks with artificial colors, sweeteners and preservatives, our clean energy drinks are just 10 calories with only 2g of organic cane sugar and are packed with natural caffeine. We call it clean energy because it’s natural energy from a single ingredient: Guayusa (gwhy-you-sa). Guayusa is a super leaf that is found almost exclusively in the Amazonian forests in Ecuador and contains more natural caffeine than two espressos. Thanks to its unique balance of polyphenols and antioxidants, the brewed guayusa leaf provides sustained energy, mental clarity, and focus without the feeling of a crash or jitters. 
 
At Runa, we’re dedicated to bringing you clean energy in every way possible. From using only natural and organic ingredients to how we source and produce our great-tasting energy drinks. We believe business is a powerful force for good and that you shouldn’t have to compromise quality for functionality. That’s why our products are Organic, Non-GMO, and Fair Trade Certified. Being Fair Trade Certified means that a fair price is paid to the farmers and a safe work environment ensured for all. We source guayusa exclusively from biodiverse forest gardens in Ecuador and work with over 3,000 farming families to implement sustainable farming practices. To date, we’ve planted over 1.2MM trees in Ecuador. It’s all part of what makes us a Certified B-Corporation. So by drinking one simple beverage you are both helping to preserve the rain forest and supporting independent farmers. And that’s just the beginning of what makes Runa so incredible.

Portable, and non-carbonated, makes these the perfect grab for busy office work days, studying, gaming, road trips, gym workouts, or days spent running around in need of a boost. Keep a shot handy for quick, delicious, caffeinated support. Stay stocked up with convenient multipack or bulk case options 
 
• A BURST OF TASTY CAFFEINE™: Each shot is bursting with a powerful flavor-forward kick that's quick, easy, and ready to wake your taste buds up. Enjoy a satisfying treat that packs a serious boost in every bottle
 
• FLAVOR PACKED: Take on busy days and long nights with caffeine comparable to a 12oz premium cup of coffee, available in all the delicious flavors you love. These shots are zero-sugar, zero-calorie, unlike other bulky, carbonated energy drinks
 
• B-VITAMINS & AMINO ACIDS: Great flavor meets the classic 5-hour ENERGY® blend to reduce fatigue and support you with energized feelings of alertness with B-vitamins, amino acids, and nutrients. Focus on your day, not looking for your next boost.
 
• FAST ACTING BOOSTS: 5-hour ENERGY® shots are quick and easy to take and pack a 230mg boost of caffeine. No mixing or shaking required. Your next boost is ready for long commutes, busy days, study sessions, and your pre-workout or exercise routine.
 
• CONVENIENT & CRAVEABLE: These delicious energy shots are portable and travel ready. They fit in your bag, car, or desk drawer for an on-the-go ready-to-drink boost. A non-carbonated partner for your next long workday, gaming marathon or gym session.
Other Ingredients: Purified Water, Natural and Artificial Flavors, Sucralose; Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate and EDTA (to Protect Freshness)

Do not use if seal is broken. Tamper evident. Caution: Contains caffeine comparable to 12 ounces of the leading premium coffee. Limit caffeine products to avoid nervousness, sleeplessness, and occasional rapid heartbeat. You may experience a Niacin Flush (hot feeling, skin redness) that lasts a few minutes. This is caused by increased blood flow near the skin. Do not take if you are pregnant or nursing. Not recommended for children. If you are taking medication or have a medical condition, consult your doctor before use. Phenylketonurics: Contains phenylalanine.

Recommended Use: Take one half (1/2) bottle for moderate energy. Take one whole bottle for maximum energy. Do not exceed two bottles daily, consumed several hours apart. Use or discard any remainder within 72 hours (three days) after opening. Refrigeration not required.

From the comfort of your own home! Farm-raised since ancient times (they're depicted in Egyptian tombs!), these moist, sweet fillets have experienced soaring popularity. Once you've tasted these delicious, freshwater selections, it will be easy to see why. Careful aquaculture nurtures the tilapia and the firm, clean filters are frozen at the pinnacle of freshness for your enjoyment. At Orca Bay, seafood is what we do. With over 30 years of exceptional seafood experience, we take pride in bringing you our winning blend of quality, value, and innovation. Meal Ideas: Focus on fresh by complementing sauteed fillets with a plate of baby greens, colorful peppers and just a sprinkle of flaky sea salt. Mint may seem like an unexpected pairing, but tied together with curry butter and ginger over a bed of roasted veggies? That'll hot the spot! Cooking Instructions: Refrigerated Thawing: Remove all packaging. Place fillets in a covered dish and thaw in refrigerator overnight. Rapid Thawing: Remove all packaging. Place fillets in a resealable bag. Immerse the sealed bag in a bowl of cold water in your sink approximately 15-20 minutes. Bake: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Place thawed fillets on a lightly oiled, low-rimmed baking pan. Brush fillets with oil and seasons as desired. Bake for 5-7 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Pan Fry: Preheat a lightly oiled nonstick frying pan to medium high. Fry thawed fillets 2 - 2-1/2 minutes per side or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Season as desired. Size and thickness of fillets will vary, adjust times accordingly. For food safety, cook seafood to an internal temperature of 145 degrees F. As measured with a food thermometer. Try it on tacos. Keep frozen. Keep frozen until ready to use. Do not refreeze.

Fresh-baked taste in 10-12 minutes. Legend: Pietro Pasquale of Suzzi, Sicily, had nine beautiful daughters and one pathetic son named Pepe. Pietro doted on his bellisimi daughters who were divine cooks, magnificent musicians and peerless students. Pepe couldn't cook, play an instrument or pass fourth grade. One day, while his sisters were at the beauty parlor, Pepe snuck into the kitchen where he was never allowed, and seeing all the baskets of succulent vegetables, cheeses, salamis and condiments, he was suddenly seized with an uncontrollable urge to cook. He twirled around the kitchen in a frenzy, grabbing flour, cheeses, pepperoni, mushrooms and vegetables, blended them in a pan, shoved it in the oven. Ecco! A delicious pie that didn't have the heavy, gushy crust and gooey topping like his sisters'. When they came home they laughed at Pepe's pizza but after they sampled a piece (pezza) they begged for more! Word spread and people from all over Sicily and beyond came to devour Pepe's pizza. His words of wisdom are engraved on Surd's City Hall: more top, less bottom. In 1804, Pep was awarded the Nobel Prize for culinary invention and herewith we present his pizza made from the very recipe he divulged in his Nobel acceptance speech.

Legend: Pietro Pasquale of Suzzi, Sicily, had nine beautiful daughters and one pathetic son named Pepe. Pietro doted on his bellisimi daughters who were divine cooks, magnificent musicians and peerless students. Pepe couldn't cook, play an instrument or pass fourth grade. One day, while his sisters were at the beauty parlor, Pepe snuck into the kitchen where he was never allowed, and seeing all the baskets of succulent vegetables, cheeses, salamis and condiments, he was suddenly seized with an uncontrollable urge to cook. He twirled around the kitchen in a frenzy, grabbing flour, cheeses, pepperoni, mushrooms and vegetables, blended them in a pan, shoved it in the oven. Ecco! A delicious pie that didn't have the heavy, gushy crust and gooey topping like his sisters'. When they came home they laughed at Pepe's pizza but after they sampled a piece (pezza) they begged for more! Word spread and people from all over Sicily and beyond came to devour Pepe's pizza. His words of wisdom are engraved on Surd's City Hall: more top, less bottom. In 1804, Pep was awarded the Nobel Prize for culinary invention and herewith we present his pizza made from the very recipe he divulged in his Nobel acceptance speech.

Talenti Gelato makes delicious, indulgent gelatos, sorbettos and frozen desserts with special ingredients, crafted just for you. We start with fresh milk and pure cane sugar - absolutely never high-fructose corn syrup, to craft our frozen dairy desserts. We then add the finest ingredients sourced from all around the world and slow cook the gelato to slightly caramelize the flavors for a one-of-a-kind tasting experience. And because we don’t add extra air into the product, you’ll enjoy a richer flavor with the denser consistency of real Italian gelato. For Talenti's Vanilla Caramel Swirl gelato frozen dessert, we source our vanilla beans from Madagascar and slow cooked in milk and cream for a caramelized vanilla gelato base. All of this makes for the most pure, intense vanilla gelato. After we have our deep vanilla base, we swirl in our signature Argentine dulce de leche. We get our dulce de leche from our friend Mario's mom's recipe from Argentina. Argentinian dulce de leche is like caramel, but richer and creamier. Even better, all our treats are milk-based rather than cream-based, so they are lower in fat. We package it in clear, recyclable, BPA-free jars to keep it fresh and to give you a peek inside. When you’re done, reuse the clear pint jar anyway you like. Try all our gelato flavors and discover your favorite!

Ben & Jerry's Vanilla ice cream pint with a chocolate cookie swirl, chocolate chip and chocolate chocolate chip cookies. Cookie madness, mixed with vanilla ice cream - has your inner cookie monster exploded with joy yet? It almost seems unfair to stack the deck like this. If the best part of your school day was sitting down to a plate of cookies and a glass of milk after you got home, is it fair to improve on that experience? We’d like to say no - but then this flavor came along. Not only do you get the perfect ratio of vanilla ice cream to cookie (no sogginess here!), you also get two kinds of cookies - regular old chocolate chip, and chocolate-chocolate chip. Oh, yes. We delved into the double-chocolate territory. And to make it even better, we also added a chocolate cookie swirl, just to maximize your cookie-eating experience. We’re sorry. (Just don’t tell your 8-year-old self that your favorite treat…just got even favorite-r). And we’ll admit: we also like playing favorites with ingredients, too. Which is why all of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream flavors are made with non-GMO sourced ingredients, and eggs from cage-free hens. In addition, the cocoa, sugar, and vanilla in Milk & Cookies come from Fairtrade certified producers - and this cookie-lover flavor also comes wrapped up in sustainably sourced packaging.

Ben & Jerry's Sweet cream ice cream pint with chunks of blonde brownies and a salted caramel core. Brace yourself, folks…this flavor is out-of-this-world euphoric. One of our most decadent Cores! Grab a flashlight and hang on tight as you journey, spoon in hand, to the core of what makes Ben & Jerry’s homemade ice cream famous. The gooey, crunchy, melt-in-your-mouth deliciousness of our Salted Caramel Core is all about adventure. Dig straight down through the gooey center of salted caramel, or work the perimeter, devouring the chunks of blonde brownies. Either way, you’ll be in total control of your ice cream destiny. What’s even better is that the brownies in this all-out amazing flavor come fresh from Greyston Bakery, located in Yonkers, New York. Since 1982, this social enterprise has been paving the way to success for many of the city’s low-income residents through employment and education. Like all of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream, Salted Caramel Core strives to not just taste delicious, but do good, by featuring Non-GMO sourced ingredients, eggs from cage-free hens, and Fairtrade certified sugar and vanilla. No artificial colors or flavors make this a frozen dessert your taste buds can trust. Like every ice cream pint we produce, it’s also wrapped in responsibly sourced packaging, so you can feel good about what’s in your freezer.

Ben & Jerry's Vanilla ice cream pint. Yes, that’s the only ingredient. Would you really want your favorite pint of vanilla to include anything else? When you dig into this pint, you’ll find a rich, creamy Vanilla that’s more vanilla-tasting than any Vanilla you’ve ever tasted. That makes sense, though because we’ve always been of the opinion that Vanilla should never be plain vanilla, if you know what we mean. Our Vanilla has a complexity that may surprise you. But there's more to our Vanilla ice cream than its incredible beyond-homemade taste. It's consciously concocted with a particularly flavorful Fairtrade vanilla blend, including vanilla made from beans grown and harvested by small-scale farmers in Uganda. They're members of local farmer associations that support sustainable farming practices. The premiums we pay for their quality vanilla help them reinvest in their families and communities for a positive change. To us, that makes every scoop all the sweeter. Talk about a win-win: Delicious ice cream and a better world. The cocoa, sugar, bananas, coffee, and vanilla in Ben & Jerry’s ice cream comes from Fairtrade certified producers. Our ice cream and frozen desserts contain Non-GMO sourced ingredients and eggs from cage-free hens, and our packaging is always responsibly sourced.

America loves chocolate ice cream, and so do we! Breyers Chocolate Ice Cream is made with Non-GMO sourced ingredients like fresh cream, milk, and sugar and is also gluten-free. And that flavorful chocolate satisfying your taste buds? That’s real cocoa we use in every ice cream tub. It's the chocolate ice cream of your dreams, rich and creamy with just the right amount of sweetness. When William Breyer started his small ice cream business in Philadelphia in 1866, he based his recipes around simple and pure ingredients. More than 150 years later, we still honor that same philosophy. We always start with high-quality ingredients like fresh cream, milk, and sugar and combine them with naturally sourced colors and flavors for wholesome goodness. This combination is how we create flavors you know and love. Our dairy comes from American farmers who produce 100% Grade A milk and cream from cows not treated with artificial growth hormones*. Discover your new favorite frozen dessert from Breyers’ many classic ice cream flavors today, like our Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream, Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream, Natural Strawberry Ice Cream, and more. * The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows.

Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Fudge Brownie ice cream pint features Fudgy chunks of brownie goodness mixed into dark and rich chocolate ice cream. Sounds like a dream. At first, that’s all it was. Long ago, we were making brownie ice cream sandwiches for sale in grocery stores. Sometimes there would be broken pieces in the brownie delivery, and we’d nab them for flavor experiments. What would brownie pieces taste like in chocolate ice cream? Pretty good, as it turns out! That original experimental flavor eventually became the legendary ice cream concoction known as Chocolate Fudge Brownie. Meanwhile, Ben Cohen had met Bernie Glassman, the founder of Greyston Bakery, a Yonkers, New York, USA-based company with a mission to end poverty and give back to the community. Equally important, their brownies were just so darn good—after sampling some, Ben handwrote a note asking for two truckloads of brownie pieces. While we knew Greyston would be the ideal supplier for turning Chocolate Fudge Brownie into a flavor sold by the tub, getting the brownies to cooperate wasn’t easy. After about 25 batches of brownies and six months of work, the flavor finally debuted in 1991, and it’s been a hit ever since. All Ben & Jerry's ice cream pints are made with non-GMO sourced ingredients and cage-free eggs. The cocoa, sugar and vanilla in the Chocolate Fudge Brownie ice cream pint is Fairtrade certified and kosher ice cream. And all our packaging is responsibly sourced. Greyston Bakery, one of the largest social enterprises in the USA, continues to provide the brownies for this and all of our flavor so you can feel good about our frozen desserts.

Ben & Jerry's Chocolate and vanilla ice cream pint with fudge brownies and a brownie batter core. This flavor takes its brownies seriously. So, nothing would do but to have two: fully baked brownies scattered liberally throughout chocolate and vanilla ice creams, and gooey, unbaked brownie batter at the core. Sure, we’re a little biased about spoons around here; if your ice cream is having such a melt-down that you’re slurping it through a straw, it’d darned well better be in a glass and called a milkshake. We’re definitely all about the spoon here. So, it didn’t take us long to realize that our favorite way to eat brownies was with our favorite utensil, straight out of the mixing bowl. But listen: we’ve got nothing against the folks who are all about the crispy edges on a pan of cooked brownies, or even those who eat their brownies with a fork and knife (even though we think it’s kind of weird). So, we decided to meet in the [Ooey gooey, brownie batter-filled] middle: batter-lovers can sink a spoon into the Core, while fully baked brownie lovers get their fix ‘round the edges. Happy bellies all around. Happy taste buds start with cage-free hens producing delicious eggs and Non-GMO sourced ingredients. Ben & Jerry's Cherry ice cream pint with cherries and fudge flakes. It’s our tribute to guitarist Jerry Garcia and his fans everywhere, and it all started with a piece of fan mail. You see, back in the day, before smartphones and social media, our fans spoke to us via handwritten notes pinned to the bulletin boards at our Scoop Shops. It was sometime in 1986 when one such fan was persistent enough to mail a postcard to our main office in Burlington, Vermont. Super premium ice cream meets great guitar solos? It was genius, and Ben immediately began creating the iconic concoction. Cherry Garcia debuted in 1987 and quickly became one of our top three most popular flavors. In fact, the first eight ice cream pints went straight to Mr. Garcia himself and were met with two thumbs up! As for the fan who sent the anonymous postcard? Our sleuths found her and thanked her with a trip to Vermont and a year’s supply of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream. It’s been a long, strange trip ever since, but what remains is Ben & Jerry's commitment to producing the world’s best frozen desserts in the most responsible way possible. Like all of our flavors, Cherry Garcia is kosher ice cream, made with non-GMO sourced ingredients, cage-free eggs, and Fairtrade certified cocoa, sugar, and vanilla. Responsibly sourced packaging gets the goodness from our Vermont factory to your freezer.

ZERO fat per serving and the delicious taste of Breyers chocolate. Creamy, delicious and made with real cocoa! And that milk is 100% Grade A from American cows not treated with artificial growth hormones*. We can’t be sure if back in 1866 our founder, William Breyer, was watching what he was eating and the amount of fat in his desserts, but we’re pretty sure he would appreciate the ingredients that we put into our Breyers Fat Free Chocolate. Back in the day Breyer committed his ice cream to follow a Pledge of Purity and use only real ingredients like milk, sugar, and real fruit and vanilla. Today we pledge to use high quality ingredients, colors and flavors from natural sources, and sustainably farmed fruit and vanilla. We believe it’s the quality of our ingredients that make our frozen desserts so good! Give Fat Free Chocolate a try and let us know by leaving a review at www.breyers.com! Follow us @Breyers on Instagram! *The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows.

Don’t be fooled by less fat and fewer calories, this light vanilla ice cream has all the creamy goodness of regular ice cream! What happens when three generations of family gather around the table? Moments and memories are made. Now’s the perfect time to pass around this creamy, rich, speckled-with-vanilla beans vanilla light ice cream, made with milk and cream. How do we make Slow Churned light ice cream with 1/3 fewer calories and 1/2 the fat but with all the creaminess and goodness of regular ice cream? We start with milk and cream and mix our special recipe for scoops of perfection every time! For nearly a hundred years, Edy's/Dreyer's has been dedicated to serving you and your families the richest, creamiest ice cream with real, high-quality ingredients the whole family can enjoy together. Today, we honor our legacy of reinvention and optimism, by celebrating the ways people remix in their everyday lives. Whether your Saturday nights are a bit out of the ordinary, or you like adding a little something extra to your dessert. At Edy's/Dreyer's, we respect the remix, and we’re right there with you. Remixing Since Forever.

Talenti Peppermint Bark Gelato is a delicious, frozen dessert that tastes like winter in a pint. We took white chocolate peppermint gelato and mixed in semi-sweet chocolatey flakes to create our Peppermint Bark Gelato frozen treat.
Talenti Gelato makes delicious, indulgent gelatos and sorbettos with special ingredients, crafted just for you. To craft our frozen dairy desserts, we start with fresh milk and pure cane sugar–absolutely never high-fructose corn syrup. We then add the finest ingredients sourced from all around the world and slow cook the gelato to slightly caramelize the flavors for a one-of-a-kind tasting experience. And because we don’t add extra air into the product, you’ll enjoy a richer flavor with the denser consistency of real Italian gelato. Talenti Peppermint Bark is a seasonal delight and the gelato version of the classic holiday favorite treat. We slowly cook peppermint extract and pieces of 100% white chocolate into milk and cream to create the gelato base so that every bite has a cool, refreshing taste of pure peppermint. We finish it off with our special semisweet chocolaty flecks for a slight crunch. They're flecks, not chips, so that they'll melt faster and not get in the way of the smooth and creamy peppermint gelato. Even better, all our frozen desserts are milk-based rather than cream-based, so they are lower in fat. This frozen dairy dessert is made with kosher, Non-GMO Sourced Ingredients. We package it in clear, recyclable, BPA-free jars to keep it fresh and to give you a peek inside. When you’re done, reuse the jar anyway you like. Try all our 40 gelato flavors and discover your favorite!

sections.bodyString:
All the texture.

Brown butter almond candy crushed into buttercream ice cream.

Years ago, Jeni was talking with a Norwegian friend who nearly teared up with joy as she shared her love of krokan—toffee-like candy made with butter, almonds, and caramelized sugar. It’s a beloved Scandinavian dessert and a favorite of author Roald Dahl (Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, James and the Giant Peach). The son of Norwegian parents, Dahl recalled krokan ice cream served at the end of big celebratory meals: “... it didn’t simply melt in your mouth like regular ice cream. You chewed it and it went crunch and the taste was something you dreamed about for days afterwards.” Inspired by this visceral love of krokan, Jeni created Brown Butter Almond Brittle in 2009. Made with rich buttercream ice cream and golden pockets of handmade almond brittle, this sweet, salty, crunchy ice cream quickly became a menu mainstay.

sections.bodyString:
Fire toasted
Fire-toasted sugar with sea salt, vanilla, and grass-grazed milk. A perfect balance of salty and sweet.

As a teen, Jeni loved learning from the French pastry apprentices at La Chatelaine, the Columbus bakery where she worked. One chef regaled her with stories of the “salty” caramel from his hometown in Brittany. What the chef meant to say was salted caramel. But, lost in translation, Jeni interpreted his version as extra-salty, like Scandinavian licorice—saltier than standard salted caramel. So when she began making ice cream a few years later, in 1996, Jeni made a burnt sugar ice cream with vanilla and a heavypinch of sea salt. What she imagined this salty French caramel tastes like. It was an instant hit. Now considered Jeni’s signature, we still make it the same way we always have—by caramelizing sugar in a kettle over fire. It’s a dangerous method that requires a lot of precision, but it’s worth it. This is why our caramel has such a beautiful, nutty quality. Adding cream and grass-grazed milk enhances the butteriness of the caramel.
Ingredients: Cream, Nonfat Milk, Cane Sugar, Tapioca Syrup, Brown Sugar, Sea Salt, Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla Extract.

From the Brambles
Oven-toasted oat streusel and a sweet-tart “brambleberry” jam of blackberries and blackcurrants layered throughout vanilla ice cream.

Brambleberry Crisp is inspired by the brambly berry bushes that litter the hillsides of the Appalachian foothills—the kinds of purple berries Jeni used to pick as a child. The sweet vanilla ice cream is made with high-quality vanilla from Madagascar and oven-toasted, brown sugar oat streusel is based on Jeni’s family recipe. The jam is made just for us—including grown-for-us blackberries from our longtime farm partner, Hirsch Fruit Farm. All of these elements come together to form a flavor reminiscent of a fresh berry fruit crisp with a scoop vanilla ice cream. First introduced in 2009 during our Foggy Mountain Collection, which highlighted the flavors and culture of Appalachia, Brambleberry Crisp was such a superstar that we had to keep it on the menu full-time.

sections.bodyString:
When William Breyer started his small ice cream business in Philadelphia in 1866, he based his recipes around simple and pure ingredients. Breyers Natural Vanilla ice cream today still holds true to his ideals. What could be simpler than using ingredients like fresh cream, sugar, and milk? To make things even sweeter, the milk and cream in this frozen treat are 100% Grade A and come from American cows not treated with artificial growth hormones*. We partner with our farmers all over America because milk and fresh cream are so important in one of our most popular ice cream flavors and the taste you love. Do you see those specks? Those are real vanilla beans. That heavenly vanilla in Natural Vanilla is also 100% sustainably sourced, so you can enjoy it even more, knowing that you’re supporting farmers and their families in Madagascar through our partnership with the Rainforest Alliance. We believe that the quality of our ingredients makes the most delicious vanilla ice cream, and that’s why even today we keep true to the William Breyers pledge of purity. Try Breyers Natural Vanilla yourself and see if you those vanilla specks and refreshing milk and cream can scoop up some smiles in your family. Add a scoop from this pint-size ice cream tub to an ice cream cone for an easy dessert. Or make an ice cream sandwich with two of your favorite cookies. Want to give your dessert a twist? Have a look at our recipes at www.breyers.com for fun and easy ideas! * The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows. 
 
• Nothing beats the delicious taste of Breyers Natural Vanilla ice cream - it's the perfect pair to your favorite desserts
 
• Ice cream made with sustainably farmed, Rainforest Alliance Certified vanilla beans and vanilla bean specks you can see
 
• Breyers partners with American Farmers to ensure its ice cream contain 100% Grade A milk and cream
 
• Breyers ice cream is made in accordance to our Breyers Pledge, starting with high-quality ingredients like fresh cream, sugar and milk
 
• This Breyers frozen treat is made with milk and cream that comes from American cows which have not been treated with Artificial Growth Hormones*
 
• Ice cream that is gluten-free and certified Kosher dairy

sections.bodyString:
In 1866, William Breyer took his passion for creating high quality desserts and set out to start his own brand of ice cream – Breyers.  Thanks to his commitment to delivering delicious ice cream using only local and simple ingredients, the Breyers brand was soon known and loved all across America. But he could have never imagined the delicious combination of creamy gelato, luscious sauces, and gourmet toppings that would follow, some 150 years later!  
Breyers Gelato Indulgences is the perfect way to take any moment from ordinary to extraordinary. Each flavor is composed of beautiful rosettes of creamy gelato, draped in luscious sauce and finished with gourmet toppings.  See for yourself how our unique trio of textures delivers a truly special and indulgent dessert experience, unlike any other. Get wrapped up in silky raspberry cheesecake gelato, give in to the temptation of creamy vanilla caramel gelato, or savor a moment of rich peanut butter.
No matter the flavor, we think you’ll agree: It’s way beyond ice cream.
Why not try  Cappuccino Gelato?
Cappuccino gelato with a foamy cream swirl & gourmet chocolate chips       
Be sure to visit www.Breyers.com to learn more about our wide variety of delicious desserts!

Talenti Gelato makes delicious, indulgent gelatos, sorbettos and frozen desserts with special ingredients, crafted just for you. A flavor loved by kids and adults who are secretly still kids, our Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough gelato frozen dessert will end your search for the perfect flavor. This upgrade of the beloved classic blends bits of real chocolate chip cookie dough and swirls of dark fudge. We start with fresh milk, cream and pure cane sugar–absolutely never high-fructose corn syrup—to create the smooth vanilla gelato base with a hint of lemon zest. We then add the finest ingredients sourced from all around the world. Not only do we have high-quality chunks of chocolate chip cookie dough, but we elevate the game even more by adding fudge swirls to keep your tongue happy. Next, we slow cook the gelato to slightly caramelize the flavors for a one-of-a-kind tasting experience. And because we don’t add extra air into the product, you’ll enjoy a richer flavor with the denser consistency of real Italian gelato.

Our pecans were meant to be roasted in butter and then surrounded by delicious Breyers to give you a delicious tasting frozen dessert. Back in 1866 when William Breyer started his small ice cream business in Philadelphia, he probably would have been seen as nuts to use the high-quality ingredients that he did. It’s the Breyers Chocolate Ice Cream you love with swirls of peanut butter. What could go wrong? We start with fresh cream, sugar, and milk, and real cocoa. In fact, we’re obsessed with the quality of the ingredients that we put into our ice creams and frozen dairy desserts. That’s why we partner with American farmers for 100% Grade A milk and cream from cows not treated with artificial growth hormones.* We also use colors and flavors from natural sources and sustainably farmed fruit and vanilla.** We work with the Rainforest Alliance to source our vanilla from farmers in Madagascar, providing income to small farmers and their communities. Our commitments to using these high-quality ingredients stem from the philosophy of our founder, William Breyer. Back in 1866, he established a Pledge of Purity to use real, quality ingredients in his ice cream products in Philadelphia. He believed that this is what made his ice cream so good. And we agree, which is why we follow his same mentality. We hope you give Breyers Chocolate Peanut Butter a try and agree. Leave us a review at Breyers.com to let us know! * The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows. **Our product, before the inclusion of any candies, cookies, sauces, or fruit from other suppliers, will fully abide by this claim.

sections.bodyString:
Ben & Jerry's Coffee vegan ice cream with fudge chunks and a caramel swirl. It will have you buzzing with euphoria with every bite!

At Ben & Jerry’s, we’re all about giving back. So, we figured our Non-Dairy Vegan diet devotees would want an extra special flavor only they could enjoy. Three years of tasting and tweaking, and our Flavor Gurus emerged with something that can only be described as pure decadence. A Non-Dairy frozen dessert exclusive chock full of fudgy chunks and a rich swirl of caramel whirled into a base of Fairtrade certified coffee goodness.

It will knock your socks off, and with almond milk as the base ingredient, you’ll be right at home, too, with the smooth and creamy texture you’d expect from Ben & Jerry’s. Make no mistake, achieving all the funky chunks and sweet swirls – without dairy, eggs, or honey – was borderline rocket science. Yet, the work (and wait) was worth it. Grab a spoon and dig in, we think you’ll agree. It’s divine!

The goodness doesn’t stop there. Ben & Jerry’s Coffee Caramel Fudge plant-based ice cream is made with non-GMO-sourced certified vegan ingredients and Fairtrade certified coffee, cocoa, and vanilla. Not to mention, the packaging is responsibly sourced, so you can feel good about what’s in your freezer.

Ben & Jerry's Vanilla with chocolate sandwich cookies and crunchy peanut butter swirls. No, you’re not dreaming…it really is Non-Dairy and Certified Vegan! When our fans asked us to offer dairy-free options, we said why not? So, we got busy in the kitchen, tasting, testing, and tweaking. Offering a vegan frozen dessert we could be proud to put our name on was no small task. It took nearly three years to perfect the recipe, but dig in, and we think you’ll agree that this frozen dessert is ridiculously delicious. In fact, this Peanut Butter & Cookies Non-Dairy frozen dessert was so good that some folks around our Vermont office couldn’t believe it was made with almond milk. Of course, being the overachievers that we are, going dairy-free was not enough, so we also made it 100% certified vegan too. It’s as good as it gets, all the while remaining boldly loaded with the chunks and swirls you’d expect from Ben & Jerry's. The best Non Dairy is nothing without great ingredients. That’s why Ben & Jerry’s is committed to crafting its products in the most responsible way possible. P. B & Cookies is a gmo free and uses Fairtrade certified cocoa, and vanilla. Discover Breyers Vanilla Ice Cream Snack Cups. These convenient ice cream snack cups are the perfect dessert for on-the-go fun. At the 1904 World's Fair, an ice cream maker ran out of bowls. He asked a nearby waffle vendor to roll waffles into cones, turning it into a finger food. In 1928 the Parker brothers (Bruce and twins I.C. and J.T. Stubby) took this great invention even further by adding chocolate coating topping with nuts. One of the brothers' wives said it looked like a fried chicken leg, thus the Drumstick novelty was born! Today Nestle Drumstick is America's No. 1 sundae cone. How do we make Slow Churned light ice cream with 1/3 fewer calories and 1/2 the fat but with all the creaminess and goodness of regular ice cream? We start with milk and cream and mix our special recipe for scoops of perfection every time! For nearly a hundred years, Edy's/Dreyer's has been dedicated to serving you and your families the richest, creamiest ice cream with real, high-quality ingredients the whole family can enjoy together. Today, we honor our legacy of reinvention and optimism, by celebrating the ways people remix in their everyday lives. Whether your Saturday nights are a bit out of the ordinary, or you like adding a little something extra to your dessert. At Edy's/Dreyer's, we respect the remix, and we’re right there with you. Remixing Since Forever.

Ben & Jerry's Chocolate ice cream and cheesecake ice creams with chocolate cookies and a cheesecake core. You can call that a tongue twister, we call it a cheesecake lover’s dream.

Here in Vermont at Ben & Jerry’s headquarters, we have a saying for those magical moments when you’re spooning with the love of your life, gazing into its irresistibly chocolatey cheesecakey core. We call it a “Core encounter of the Ben & Jerriest kind,” and it’s been known to leave people speechless (mainly due to over-scooping). It’s life changing to say the least, and we encourage you to experience it as soon as possible.

A perfect place to start is Ben & Jerry’s Cookies & Cream Cheesecake Core – hands down one of the most euphoric flavors we’ve ever created. Aim your spoon straight for its center and get swept off your feet with the decadently delicious cheesecake core. Then work the perimeter, pleasing your taste buds with chocolate and cheesecake ice creams packed with chocolate cookie chunks. In a word…it’s aahhmazing!

Like all of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream, Cookies & Cream Cheesecake Core strives to not just taste delicious, but do good by featuring Non-GMO sourced ingredients and cage-free eggs. Fairtrade certified producers supply the cocoa, sugar, and vanilla; and our packaging is responsibly sourced.

These flavors offer an alternative, yet still indulgent gelato with half the sugar than regular ice cream. The Mint Cookie Crunch flavor has a true mint taste, in fact we steep real mint leaves in fresh milk and cream for flavor. We then sweeten with chocolate cookie crunch pieces (which add a great crunch) and monk fruit juice sweetener (a low calorie sugar alternative). At Talenti, we believe the best process and highest quality ingredients results in the best tasting gelato and sorbetto. We start with fresh milk and cream and make each flavor from scratch with the highest-quality ingredients sourced from all around the world. We then use an old world process that involves slow cooking our ingredients in smaller batches to bring out unique flavors for a one-of-a-kind dessert. We package our gelato in clear, BPA-free jars to showcase the beautiful gelato inside. When you’re done, recycle or reuse* the jar anyway you like. Chocolate and cherry light ice creams with cherries and fudge flakes.
For one sizzling-hot second in 2016, Chocolate Cherry Garcia took the stage for an epic flavor riff that got fans of the original completely amped. But that was a Limited Batch flavor, and like all truly great guitar solos, it faded away after its final chords.
And yet, there are echoes of greatness still ringing in the halls of Ben & Jerry’s, as Cherry Garcia With A Twist Moo-phoria makes its entrance! With all of the same chunks and swirls that you know and love — but with fewer calories and less fat — Cherry Garcia With a Twist is Chocolate Cherry Garcia’s lighter, fitter protégé! 
But while we may have gone with light chocolate and cherry ice creams, we didn’t skimp on any of the flavor — or our ethics. Cherry Garcia with a Twist is made with Fairtrade certified cocoa, sugar, and vanilla, and non-GMO ingredients. We use cage-free eggs and milk from the happy cows in our Caring Dairy Program. All of that is packaged up in sustainably sourced materials for a 190 calorie treat that’s fit to make a new generation of groupies feel great about carrying on the legend.

Ben & Jerry's Peanut butter light ice cream pint with marshmallow swirls & peanut butter cookies.
When Ooey meets gooey, our minds go ka-flooey - but never more so than when Ooey meets gooey in a pint of Moo-phoria (Ooey)! Particularly when there are also peanut butter cookies involved.
Yup. That's what we said: smooth, creamy peanut butter light ice cream swirled with ribbons of gooey marshmallow, all chunked up with peanut butter cookies - for 220 calories per serving. You might wonder how we did it. (In fact, we admit to being slightly bamboozled ourselves). But here's the thing: When you start with a fluffernutter sandwich as your inspiration, you've got a little room to get creative around the concept of Ooey, gooey, and delicious.
Just one thing: we might have cut out some fat in this low-calorie ice cream and gloriously delicious pint of PB Marshmallow Swirl frozen treat, but we didn't skimp on our commitment to using Non-GMO ingredients, or eggs from cage-free hens. Our milk comes from the happy cows in our Caring Dairy Program, and we use Fairtrade certified sugar and vanilla, all wrapped up in responsibly sourced packaging to keep all the Ooey gooey goodness fresh and delicious until you're ready to grab a spoon and dig in.

Ben & Jerry's Vanilla ice cream with peanut butter cookies, peanut butter ice cream with fudge chips, and a no bake cookie dough core. Lovers of cookie dough: this one's for you! Our Flavor Gurus have taken the classic no-bake cookie and turned it into something even more euphoric (because: ice cream).

Even if you don't have the morning time munchies, you'll get lost in this multidimensional flavor. Two ice cream flavors - yeah that's right, we went there - gently caress a thick no-bake cookie dough core that harkens back to those gooey, chocolatey, peanut buttery cookies that your grandma used to make back in the day. Add in chunks of peanut butter cookies and fudge chips, and you've got yourself an indulgent dessert extravaganza that will vanquish any sweet tooth. Really, has combining chocolate, peanut butter, and vanilla ever not been a fantastic idea? We think not. And with cookie dough in every single bite, this pint is a dough lover's dream come true. So grab a spoon and dig in!

Wake & No Bake Cookie Dough Core isn't just about the euphoria, it's also made with the best ingredients: non-GMO sourced ingredients, eggs from cage-free hens, and Fairtrade Certified vanilla, cocoa, and sugar. And responsibly sourced packaging to boot! Now that's sweet!

This frozen treat is made with cheesecake gelato with layers of chocolate chunks, black cherry sauce, cheesecake gelato, and graham cookies. Cherry cheesecake is a classic dessert, and we think our frozen dessert is a soon-to-be classic.
At Talenti, we believe the best process and highest quality ingredients results in the best tasting gelatos, sorbettos and frozen desserts. We start with fresh milk and cream and make each flavor from scratch with the highest-quality ingredients sourced from all around the world. With every recipe, Talenti adds a twist to make each pint extra special. Finally, we use an old world process that involves slow cooking our ingredients in small batches to bring out delicious flavors for one-of-a-kind frozen desserts. sections.bodyString: Breyers vanilla and heaps of crème-filled chocolate cookie pieces? Yes, please! Breyers Cookies & Cream Light Ice Cream Dessert combines your love of Breyers vanilla with chocolate cookie pieces. In this delicious frozen dessert, rich, creamy vanilla goodness surrounds chunks of chocolate crème-filled cookies. It's the milk and cookie break we know you've been craving!  When William Breyer started his small ice cream business in Philadelphia in 1866, he based his recipes around simple and pure ingredients. More than 150 years later, we still honor that same philosophy. We always start with high-quality ingredients like fresh cream, milk, and sugar and combine them with naturally sourced colors and flavors for wholesome goodness. This combination is how we create flavors you know and love. Our dairy comes from American farmers who produce 100% Grade A milk and cream from cows not treated with artificial growth hormones*. The vanilla in this frozen dairy dessert is made with 100% sustainable vanilla that is Rainforest Alliance Certified. Want even more cookie goodness? Try our new Double Cookie Crumble. It’s the perfect trio of sweet cream Breyers, chunks of crème-filled chocolate cookies and a yummy chocolate cookie swirl. *The FDA states that no significant difference has been shown between dairy derived from rBST-treated and non-rBST-treated cows.

Ben & Jerry's Mascarpone ice cream with fudge-covered pastry shell pieces and mascarpone swirls. You asked, you begged, you sent us cannolis in the mail in protest. And finally — FINALLY — we’re bringing back one of our most-requested fan favorites: Cannoli!

It all started with Holy Cannoli, a Limited Batch flavor that launched in 1997. You remember 1997: The era of tiny sunglasses, platform shoes, and a certain movie about a big boat that had an unfortunate encounter with an iceberg. But even though Holy Cannoli was not long for freezer shelves, it lived on in the hearts and dreams of ice cream fans. So, in 2012, we gave in to our fans and brought it back as Cannoli. And it was so popular that we had to extend its limited availability to keep up with demand. You’d think we’d have learned by then: People love cannolis, and people really love cannoli ice cream. But no, we didn’t learn. We yanked it from shelves, and only now are rectifying what could be referred to as the greatest ice cream travesty of the last 20 years. So now we make amends to you, dear cannoli lovers. Take this frozen treat as a symbol of our love for you and your exacting tastes. The best part? It’s here to stay, unlike those tiny sunglasses.

Even sweeter? Cannoli is made with Fairtrade Certified cocoa, vanilla, and sugar, non-GMO sourced ingredients, and eggs from cage-free hens.

Est. Brooklyn 2008. A life without anything good is bad. Ever since 2008, when Van Leeuwen was born out of a yellow truck on the streets of NYC, we've been making good ice cream from good ingredients that makes you feel good. Popsicle Pops has been a treasured American treat for over 100 years and remains America’s favorite ice pop.
In 1905 11 year old boy, Frank Epperson invented the first ice pop. One night Frank poured soda powder into water and mixed it with a stirring stick. He accidently left the mixture outside all night in the cold. Frank awoke the next morning to find his drink was frozen like an icicle. It was a hit with his friends and a classic was born!

Inspired by the show & the host we love staying up late for, here’s a flavor you’ll love without needing a spoon for – dedicated to SeriousFun Children’s Network of global camps for kids with serious illnesses. Learn more at seriousfunnetwork.org.

We all have that friend who has a hack for everything. You know the one: they know how to get every stain and spot out; how to magic chaos into calm; how to peel a hard-boiled egg without swearing—you name it, they’ve got it handled. We’re not going to pretend we’re that person. But we do know the best way to eat ice cream late at night is not with a spoon, but in a pint slice—especially when watching our favorite late-night TV host. No pesky utensil to force an intermediary between you and instant euphoria—and you can always deploy your pint slice as a polite cover-up when you (inevitably) start giggling with your mouth full. 

We’d argue that this flavor is actually at its best as a slice, thanks to that layer of dark-chocolate cookie-crumb coating that hides caramel ice cream with chocolate-cookie swirls and PB-chocolate-chip cookie dough inside. And, like all Ben & Jerry’s flavors, it’s made from cage-free eggs and with non-GMO ingredients. It also features Fairtrade-certified sugar, cocoa, and vanilla for a delicious and ethically sourced treat.

sections.bodyString:
At Magnum, we believe that a day without indulgence is a day lost. That's why we have been creating decadent ice cream indulgences since 1989. Magnum Dark Chocolate Truffle Mini Ice Cream bars are made with dark chocolate ice cream dipped in dark chocolate with a rich dark chocolate ganache swirl. And because they're mini, they're the perfect anytime frozen dessert. Using cocoa beans sourced from Rainforest Certified Farms, each bar is made with 68% cacao Belgian dark chocolate, for a luxurious treat unlike any other.

Beyond our Mini variety pack, you can explore the full range of Magnum ice cream bars and discover an expansive world of pleasure. Each ice cream bar is made with Belgian chocolate that uses cocoa beans sourced from Rainforest Alliance Certified™ farms. Belgian chocolate has an outstanding reputation for its smooth, rich flavor and tempting chocolate aroma. It's recognized around the world because of its meticulous adherence to ‘Old World' craftsmanship.

Magnum premium ice cream bars are crafted in this rich heritage and are made with a signature Belgian chocolate recipe developed specifically for us. While still warm, this delicious coating wraps around our velvety ice creams, instantly cooling to leave our signature solid, thick shell – ready and waiting to be cracked. From intense to sweet to salty to dark, which one will satisfy your next snack indulgence?

Each ice cream bar is made with velvety smooth ice cream and is covered in a chocolatey coating, toasted almond pieces, a layer of luscious sauce, and a final thick chocolate coating made with premium milk and dark chocolate. The result is a frozen treat, the perfect combination of delicious flavors and textures in every bite. Magnum Ice Cream Almond Duet Bars are a delight for the senses: Almond ice cream is dipped in milk chocolate, a layer of brown sugar almond butter sauce, and then half-dipped in a crackly shell of premium chocolate. Our premium chocolate is made with cocoa beans sourced from Rainforest Alliance Certified™ farms. Our premium chocolate is renowned for its smooth, rich flavor and decadent texture, and it’s recognized around the world because of its meticulous adherence to “Old World” craftsmanship. That makes it perfect for our ice cream bars because we craft our premium ice cream bars in accordance with this rich heritage, using a signature premium chocolate recipe developed specifically for us. While still warm, this delicious chocolate coating wraps around our velvety ice creams, instantly cooling to form our signature thick, crackly chocolate shell. With flavors ranging from intense to sweet to salty to dark, Magnum Ice Cream is sure to satisfy your next dessert craving, whatever it is.

Outshine Strawberry Frozen Fruit Bars are a satisfying frozen snack that refreshes you from the inside out. Made with real fruit, every bite of these delicious freezer pops tastes like biting into a ripe summertime strawberry. Unlike many other frozen snacks, Outshine Frozen Fruit Bars are made with wholesome ingredients that you can enjoy without compromise. These gluten-free and fat-free snacks are also made with no artificial colors** or flavors, focusing instead on real fruit for a delicious treat that not only tastes good, but feels good too. Try the whole range of Outshine Frozen Fruit Bars to find your new favorite summertime snack or after-dinner delight. Choose from fruit bars, simply indulgent bars, half-dipped bars, fruit bars with no sugar added, and variety packs. Ben and Jerry started selling ice cream from a renovated gas station in Burlington, Vermont, in 1978, which (sorry, guys!), makes them officially old. But because we’re pretty darned fond of the two dudes who have contributed so much peace, love, and ice cream to the world for the past four decades, we think they just get better with age. 

The same could be said for Cherry Garcia; while this euphorically delicious tribute to guitarist Jerry Garcia has been around since 1986, it’s still one of our most popular flavors! That’s inspired a few riffs on the original; we’ve swapped out vanilla ice cream for cherry; then switched up vanilla for chocolate; it’s been made with frozen yogurt, GREEK frozen yogurt, molded into ice-cream bars, mini-cups, and quart tubs…and now it’s even available as a pint slice—no spoon required. Now that’s vintage perfection!

Through all the slicing and dicing, we’ve kept one thing constant: our commitment to non-GMO ingredients and cage-free eggs. Klondike® Donuts Wake Me Up Coffee frozen dairy dessert combines the magic of Klondike bars with the deliciousness of your favorite donut — and the results are outrageously good. Sweet and decadent with a chocolatey hard shell outside, and bold coffee flavor inside, this frozen snack is unlike anything you've tried before. It's also made with 100% Arabica Colombian Coffee. One box contains six individually wrapped treats, so you can enjoy at home or on the go, and share with friends, family and kids of all ages. Like many iconic American brands, Klondike® began with humble roots and flourished through hard work, passion and a commitment to quality. The origins of the Klondike® Bar can be traced back to William Isaly, the son of Swiss immigrants, who founded the Isaly Dairy Company in Ohio during the early 1900s. The original Klondike® Ice Cream Bar was handmade by dipping square slices of homemade ice cream into pans of rich, delicious Swiss milk chocolate. By the 1940s, the Isaly family had several dairy plants that supplied more than 300 Isaly Dairy stores. Klondike® Ice Cream Bars were sold in all stores. If you're in the mood for something totally delicious and just a bit out of the ordinary, be sure to try other items from our Donuts line of fun, frozen dairy dessert treats including Frosted Strawberry, Triple Chocolate, and Boston Cream treats. Rest assured that this frozen snack is Certified Kosher and uses dairy from cows that were never treated with artificial growth hormones.

sections.bodyString: Chocolate light ice cream with artificially flavored marshmallow light ice cream and chopped almonds between chocolate flavored wafers. Wells quality since 1913. Not a light food. Chocolate and marshmallows and almonds, oh my! The Rocky Road flavor was created in 1929 following the stock market crash - blah blah blah. Let's get to the good stuff! We start with rich chocolate ice cream swirled with thick ribbons of marshmallow ice cream (you deserve more than those little bitty marshmallows) and then mix in crunchy chopped almonds. Just take one bite and we guarantee your taste buds will be at the intersection of Rocky Road and Delicious Drive! Real Ice Cream: For nearly 100 years Wells' Dairy, Inc. has been committed to providing quality dairy products to delight our consumers! To us quality is more than just the process of making ice cream - it's about the ingredients that go into it. Not all sandwiches today are made with real ice cream. However, Blue Bunny sandwiches still use only real ice cream, made from the finest dairy ingredients. Light Ice Cream fat reduced 55% and calories reduced 10% from regular ice cream. Fat reduced from 10 g to 4.5 g and calories from 190 to 170 per 100 grams. The ice cream capital of the world. It may sound like a fairy tale, but it's all true. The town is real. sections.bodyString: Wake up and give your taste buds a bite of that good morning feeling! Jimmy Dean Delights Plant Based Breakfast Sandwiches are the perfect way to enjoy a delicious breakfast with the family every morning. Crafted with our wholesome plant based patty, fluffy spinach and egg white frittata, and irresistibly melty cheese between a delicious whole grain English muffin, these delicious sandwiches kickstart your and your family’s mornings and help fuel the day ahead. Folks will be hard pressed to find a breakfast loaded with such irresistible flavor and that can effortlessly be served in just minutes. Simply place a sandwich in the microwave and heat. Grab a warm Jimmy Dean Sandwich and have a great tasting snack at the ready. Add a sandwich to your lunch and take with you to the office for a midday pick-me-up, or pack one in a school lunch for a tasty treat. Each individual sandwich is packaged in a single-serving wrapper, making it the ideal meal to take with you when you’re on the move. Or better yet, prepare a meal at home that the family will love! Pair a sandwich with your favorite medley of fruit, yogurt, or simply savor the familiar flavors of a Jimmy Dean sandwich all on its own, exactly as it was intended. Or even add a dash of ketchup or your favorite hot sauce for a more tangy bite.

Twelve 2.1 oz (60 g) packages. Contains a bioengineered food ingredients. Twin wrapped. McKee - A family bakery. Peanuts: An American favorite. America's obsession with peanut butter boils down to the key ingredient, the peanut. Peanuts are a versatile snack. Whether salted, sweetened, roasted or boiled - peanuts and peanut butter are a delicious source of protein. Fun Facts: Peanut plants flower above the ground while the peanuts grow underground. They are planted in the spring and are normally ready to harvest by fall. While peanuts are grown in 13 states of the US, Georgia plants more peanuts than any other state. Make Your Own Ghostly Costume: What You'll Need: large white cloth; roll of thin medical gauze; craft glue; scissors; plastic spiders (if desired). Take a large white cloth and cut two small holes for your eyes to see through. Ask an adult to help you cut the bottom of the sheet so you don't trip! Special effects! Glue long pieces of gauze onto the body of your costume in layers to make it look like a web. Glue plastic spiders onto the gauze. Draw fun shapes like bats, half-moons and cats on the cloth with a glow-in-the-dark marker; Wear dark pants and a white top and slip the cloth over your head. Now you're ready to trick or treat!

The small artisan pastry shop grew oever the years into a company. Today we sacredly preserve Matilde's recipe book, applying her creations as a current source of inspiration for our sweet foundation. Over the years, innovation and tradition have remained the fundamental ingredients of our success. Drake Baking Company in Harlem, New York City. 1926: Drake's Devil Dogs burst into the snack cake scene. 1928: Yankee Doodles, the delicious Drake's cupcakes, are introduced. 1930: Newman Drake passes, donating land for a park in his hometown of Newton, New Jersey. 1939: Drake's participates in the 1939 New York World's Fair. 1958: Drake's launches the often imitated, never duplicated Ring Dings. 1961: Peanut butter Funny Bones start tickling the fancies of cake lovers. 1962: Drake's rolls out Yodels, the rolled devil's food and creme-filled cakes. 1964: Drake's introduces what is today. Drake's Fruit Pies. 1981: Consumers vote to name the Drake's duck mascot Webster. 2016: Drake's celebrates 120 years of delicious tradition. Questions or comments, call 1-855-403-7253 (1-855-40-Drake). Sealed to preserve quality and freshness.

It's that signature taste that has become the trademark of Michigan cherries. Home grown. Michigan. Festivals. Fruit pies. Michigan offers an ideal climate and topography for bountiful cherry orchards. No one knows this fruit better than the American family farms whose hard work and passion for cherries have lasted for generations. Their dedication makes each bite taste that much richer! In any given year, close to 250 million pounds of red tart cherries are grown in North America - many coming from Michigan communities whose love of cherries is celebrated each year with a National Cherry Festival at the beginning of July, bringing both the fruit and the region to life.

Drake's Fruit Pies. 1981: Consumers vote to name the Drake's duck mascot Webster. 2016: Drake's celebrates 120 years of delicious tradition. drakescake.com. sections.bodyString:
The original. The classic. The greatest. Hailing from their birthplace of Brooklyn, New York, Devil Dogs have been the golden, chocolatey child of Drake's Cakes since 1926. Now beloved around the nation, you can't call yourself a true cake fan without having tried this delicious cake classic. Two fun-shaped devils food cakes give our Devil Dogs their name. We take those cakes and sandwich them around an abundance of rich Drake's vanilla-flavored creme. With cake so fluffy and creme so sweet, Devil Dogs go down so well with a glass of milk or a cup of coffee! Even on their own, they'll be the best dogs you've ever had. 
 
• 8 Creme Filled Devils Food Cakes per carton
 
• Individually wrapped
 
• Certified Kosher by the Orthodox Union
 
• Freshness guaranteed

A New York favorite since 1958. Don't fall for those other onomatopoeia knockoffs. Drake's Cakes original Ring Dings are often imitated, never duplicated. Think of them as your own personal miniature devils food cakes. Our classic round devils food cakes are loaded with rich, Drake's vanilla-flavored creme. We finish these tasty treats by drenching them in Drake's thick, rich frosting. Put a candle in it, call it a Tuesday and indulge. You deserve it. Eight individually wrapped cakes per carton make it the perfect on-the-go snack. Some people say it makes a perfect after-dinner treat or after-school goody for the kids; that is, if you're willing to share. Ring Dings are here for you to relive your childhood memories, or to supply you with a new favorite if you've never been fortunate enough to try the original.
